Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: All-hands Friday 9:30am PT (HQ + Zoom). Short agenda + two asks below. Please add quick Qs here or use the anonymous form: https://forms.redwood.internal/ah-quickq (closes Thu 5pm).

Maya (People Ops): Agenda (20m):
• 6m — Company snapshot & hiring priorities (Zoe)
• 5m — Launch readiness checklist & playbook highlights (Kei)
• 4m — Runtime rollout: cache prefetch + canary plan (Ravi)
• 3m — Security note: key rotation & retention tweak (Ana)
• 2m — GTM: renewal FAQ + partner mention (Tess)
• 0-?m — Live Q&A (brief)

Maya (People Ops): Asks: 1) If you want to demo, post 1-line blurb + infra needs. 2) Upload slides to drive.redwood.internal/allhands/friday-2026 by Thu noon.

Zoe (CEO): I'll open with a short update on runway and one leadership request: call out any cross-team blockers.

Kei (Product): We'll surface the playbook checklist and a short metric target for launch success. Requesting 2 slides.

Ravi (Eng): Eng will show a tiny clip of the prefetch change (local perf). Needs presenter perms. Low-risk.

Ana (Security): Quick heads-up: we'll announce a rolling KMS key rotation schedule and a small change to internal logs retention for debug buckets. No customer-facing changes, but if you're using long-term internal caches, check Ana's follow-up doc.

Tess (RevOps): On renewals: we'll mention a small pricing adjustment for Dedicated bundles. RevOps will prepare a one-pager for CSMs; tagging @Finance for numbers.

Maya (People Ops): Note: recording + captions will be posted to #all-hands-recordings and the drive. If you need clips, DM me start/end times after the meeting.

Ravi (Eng): Can we get the Zoom link pinned with co-host rights for presenters?

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "All-Hands 1 Launch Readiness" Fri 09:30 PT 1 Zoom link pinned.

Kei (Product): Small ask: include a 30s customer quote after product slides. If you have a line, paste it here.

Tess (RevOps): Adding partner shoutout after product. Also will upload the renewals FAQ draft by Thu 11am.

Ana (Security): FAQ: retention tweak only affects internal debug logs stored in "logs-debug" buckets. Dedicated customer defaults unchanged. Full scope in the brief I'll share.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — please confirm slide upload here once done. Looking forward to a crisp session. :sparkles:
